_comment: Performance budgets (#31). bundle_gzip_kb: gzip-9 KB of web/dist (scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs), measured + ~20%. query_*: hot server actions on the city-scale seed in web/src/lib/queryBudgets.test.ts. The primary query guard is the plan check there (no full SCAN of a growing table); query_ms is the median of 7 runs, set at 10x the measured median with a 1 ms floor so it catches only large regressions, not CI noise; query_max_rows is the measured row count + 20% (exactly 1 for single-row lookups). page_actions: exact server round trips (registered-action calls) per hot page load, counted by the a11y gate's platform mock (e2e/a11y/query-count.spec.ts); no headroom, so adding a call is a deliberate change. Change a budget only with a recorded reason (README.md, Performance budgets).
